title: ESPN reports Mike Vrabel was in "constant contact" with Patriots on Saturday, retracts it

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: ESPN reports Mike Vrabel was in "constant contact" with Patriots on Saturday, retracts it
sources.description: The NFL's biggest story of the month — which has crossed over to national news, morning shows, and late-night TV — had a fairly big development on Saturday, when Patriots coach Mike Vrabel skipped the third day of the draft to attend counseling.
